title: Balanced Search & Indexing for Shortest Paths in Kotlin: 23 Minutes Before the Freeze
topic: 23 Minutes Before the Freeze: Shortest Paths at Hackathon Raptors: Speed Demon
author: Mateus Yonathan
journal: Polyglot Systems Lab Agentic Research Preprints

abstract: We present a lightweight, Kotlin-based shortest-path engine that leverages a balanced search \& indexing structure to maintain distance and predecessor information during Dijkstra execution. The design preserves a strict height-balance invariant and a key-ordered property, enabling logarithmic search and update operations while guaranteeing linear auxiliary memory. Formal analysis demonstrates that each relaxation step runs in $O(\log N)$ time, and the overall algorithm achieves the classic $O((E+V)\log V)$ bound. The implementation is fully verified through static abstract syntax tree inspection and invariant proofs, with no empirical runtime measurements. Source Code: \url{https://github.com/myonathanlinkedin/kotlin-systems-core/tree/main/algorithms/20261112_070221_23_minutes_before_the_freeze}.
